description:
Your Impact

The Director, GTM Enablement builds and leads the enablement function that turns DISCO’s strategy into field performance. Working with Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Strategy, Operations, and Product, they own enablement for the full revenue organization: SDRs, AEs, RSEs, and CSMs. They are measured by business results, not training adoption or volume: faster ramp, higher win rates, shorter sales cycles, stronger retention and expansion, and consistent execution in the field. As DISCO moves from its software foundation to its next phase of growth, they help the field keep up with what we sell.

What You'll Do

  • Enablement Strategy and Priorities: Sets a clear, outcome-based enablement roadmap across content, training, and measurement. Decides the strategy for the enablement function including what to build and what to stop, based on revenue impact, field feedback, and performance data.
  • Onboarding and Ramp: Owns the onboarding and certification path for new revenue hires, with a defined target ramp time and measured productivity. Partners with Product, Marketing, and Operations so new hires reach fluency on the platform, personas, and positioning quickly. 
  • Manager-led coaching: Equips frontline managers to coach continuously, with coaching guides, monthly manager kits, and reinforcement after training. Success means behavior change that managers can see, not completed courses.  
  • Sales and CS content: Works with Product Marketing to maintain a focused set of assets, including pitch decks, battlecards, playbooks, and talk tracks, and retires what the field doesn’t use. 
  • Methodology and process adoption: Drives adoption of DISCO’s sales methodology and processes, and shows whether they improve qualification, forecast accuracy, and win rates. Raise concerns early when something isn’t landing with the field.
  • AI and tools: Uses AI to build content, practice scenarios, and scalable coaching, and make the current sales tech stack work before recommending new tools. Brings a business case for any new platform, including call recording and conversation intelligence. 
  • Measurement and reporting: Defines the metrics that show enablement impact (ramp time, win rate, cycle time, adoption, and the business outcomes behind them) and reports them to leadership each quarter, including what isn’t working. 
  • Team leadership: Leads and develops an enablement team, sets clear expectations and goals, delegates real ownership, and builds a high-accountability, high-trust culture. Owns hiring, workforce planning, and headcount decisions for the enablement function in partnership with leadership.

Who You Are

  • 15+ years in sales, field, or revenue enablement (or a related GTM role) in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or a similar high-growth environment. 
  • 2+ years of people management, with experience building or scaling an enablement function. 
  • A track record of measurable revenue impact, such as shortening ramp time, improving win rates or cycle times, or driving real adoption of a methodology or program. 
  • Experience rolling out a sales methodology (MEDDPICC or similar) and showing it changed field behavior and outcomes, not just completion. 
  • Practical experience using AI to improve content creation, coaching, or enablement workflows and driving AI adoption across the team 
  • Experience with revenue tooling, including Salesforce CRM, conversation intelligence, Outreach, and Learning Management Systems
  • Strong analytical and storytelling skills (and a bias for simplifying and prioritizing) with the ability to translate data into business impact for executives and senior leaders 
  • Ability to work across functions with Sales, CS, Product Marketing, Product, and Operations, including influencing senior leaders
  • Experience with MEDDPICC, other selling methodologies, Chorus, Salesforce 
  • Ability to design content, playbooks, and training from real customer conversations and complex enterprise sales cycles 
  • Knowledge of instructional design frameworks applied pragmatically for fast field adoption 
  • Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across all levels of the organization and align team on company goals 
  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and drive them to completion on schedule 
  • Outstanding creative skills for crafting engaging and compelling learning content 
  • Proficiency in sales enablement technologies and tools, such as CRM systems, sales engagement platforms, and content management systems

Authorization to Work in the U.S.: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future. DISCO is not currently sponsoring visas, including, but not limited to, H-1B, TN, or EAD, and we are not accepting visa transfers.

Perks of DISCO 

  • Open, inclusive, and fun environment
  • Benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, as well as 401(k) 
  • Competitive salary plus RSUs
  • Flexible PTO 
  • Opportunity to be a part of a company that is revolutionizing the legal industry
  • Growth opportunities throughout the company

About DISCO

DISCO provides a cloud-native, artificial intelligence-powered legal solution that simplifies ediscovery, legal document review and case management for enterprises, law firms, legal services providers and governments. Our scalable, integrated solution enables legal departments to easily collect, process and review enterprise data that is relevant or potentially relevant to legal matters. 

At DISCO, we believe AI is a core enabler of how work gets done. All employees are expected to proactively adopt and responsibly use AI tools to drive efficiency, improve outcomes, and continuously evolve how they operate in their role.

Are you ready to help us fulfill our mission to use technology to strengthen the rule of law? Join us! 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
